create_entity_subclass: create a subclass of Entity that implements _build to wrap a custom MJCF model
attach_entity_to_parent: attach an Entity to a parent Entity at a specified site using the attach method
get_entity_pose: get the position and orientation quaternion of an Entity relative to its parent using get_pose
set_entity_velocity: set the linear and angular velocity of a free Entity using set_velocity
configure_entity_joints: configure all internal joint positions of an Entity using configure_joints
